audit_items.proof_trace: Memory allocation occurs based on declared RLP sequence length before validating sufficient data exists. LogEntryDecoder.cs:46 allocates Hash256[] with size = sequenceLength/33 directly from untrusted input. The subsequent Read() operations will throw when actual data is exhausted, but only after O(declared_length) memory is already allocated, violating the O(actual_input_length) resource bound.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Send malformed P2P receipt message with log entry declaring topics sequence length of 2GB while providing only KB of actual data. The decoder allocates ~60M Hash256 objects before failing, causing memory exhaustion DoS. Attack is reachable via eth/66 receipt exchange.
